title: Spiced {p} & {v} Dal
steps: Rinse the {p}. Simmer dried lentils or chickpeas in water until soft; canned beans only need draining. Dried kidney beans need soaking, then a hard boil of at least 10 minutes.
Bloom the {spice} in oil with a little garlic for 30 seconds, then add the {v} and cook until soft.
Add the {p}, the {sauce} and a cup of water. Simmer 15 minutes, mashing some of the {p} to thicken.
Serve over the {s} with lemon or fresh herbs.
tip: Lentils and beans give protein and fiber for very little cost, and a teaspoon of oil is enough to bloom the spices.
